Subarnarekha Valley Corporation
Office of the Executive Engineer · Delhi · IN

Dated: 2026-03-31
Certificate of Completion of Work
This is to certify that the work of “Process Piping Package — Delhi Pkg-82” (industrial epc), awarded to
M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been
completed in all respects on 2016-07-20 at a gross executed value of INR 41,42,00,000/- (Rupees 41.42
Crore Only).
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on satisfactory
completion of the final inspection.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Meera Roy. This certificate is issued for record and for
submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
Executive Engineer
Subarnarekha Valley Corporation
